tex_content.html: \begin{equation} E_j=\begin{cases} [0,2^0/32),& j=0,\\[2^{j-1}/32,2^j/32),& \ArrayCell j>0. \end{cases} \end{equation} The endpoint $T_j=2^j/32$ is the start of the next physical epoch. A prefix is seed-compatible when it uses the fixed setup, $\kappa _0$ is its initial noncollapsing constant, and $\Delta _0$ is the value in (2). The noncollapsing induction has the following quantified form: \begin{theorem} [Noncollapsing induction on an observed epoch]]\end{cases}\ArrayRow \ArrayCell \end{equation}(2)
